verdict.rationale: Wrike documents configurable dashboards and real-time visual reports, which suggest some cross-work tracking. However, no evidence explicitly shows progress from multiple projects rolled up into a single portfolio view. The 'portfolio' mention covers budget planning, not progress rollup, and BI export is a workaround. Missing for 10: explicit cross-project progress rollup, a dedicated portfolio view for progress, any detail on aggregation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view
